creatures.name: Skreel Brood
creatures.desc: Chitinous hounds that pour out of tunnels in their hundreds. Every brood carries the template for the next one.

creatures.name: Echo Mimic
creatures.desc: A black, boiling thing that becomes a rock, a crate or a lamp post until something warm walks past. Then it becomes teeth.

creatures.name: Drift Grazer Herd
creatures.desc: Six-legged, slow and gentle. They hum when they are happy. A whole economy could be built on their milk.

creatures.name: Cog-Walker Colony
creatures.desc: Round-headed machine life that crawled out of a buried factory and learned to want things. Mostly they want to be left alone.

creatures.name: Glasswing Raptors
creatures.desc: Flocks of transparent hunters you see only by the light they bend. They go for sensors first.

creatures.name: Tide Lurker
creatures.desc: Coils under the shallows and waits for hulls.

creatures.name: Rogue Hunter-Killer
creatures.desc: A war machine from a war nobody remembers. It still has its last order. The order was everything.

creatures.name: Tendril Sentinel
creatures.desc: A floating cluster of red eyes and cutting tendrils. It patrols in long, silent arcs and never, ever stops.

creatures.name: Gravid Stalker
creatures.desc: It does not eat what it kills. It plants something in it. Kill them before the carriers wake up.

creatures.name: Necroform Shamblers
creatures.desc: Bodies rebuilt by a signal into something with too many blades. Burn the limbs off; the heads do not matter.

creatures.name: Rime Strider
creatures.desc: A long-legged hunter that walks the ice on six stilts and listens for heartbeats through the glacier.

creatures.name: Magma Eel
creatures.desc: Swims through molten rock like water. Leaves glass where it surfaces.

creatures.name: Spore Choir
creatures.desc: A forest of fruiting bodies that sings in the ultrasound. Anything that listens too long starts walking toward it.

creatures.name: Thresher Burrower
creatures.desc: A burrowing mouth the size of a tower block. You know one is near when the ground starts to breathe.

creatures.name: Deepsand Wyrm
creatures.desc: It comes for rhythm: engines, footsteps, drills. Where it has passed, the dunes are sweet with a strange red spice.

creatures.name: Pyre Drake
creatures.desc: A flying furnace with a wingspan you measure in city blocks. It raids for metal and leaves slag.

creatures.name: Breach Kaiju
creatures.desc: Something came through the trench. It is bigger than anything with a skeleton should be, and it is walking toward the coast.

creatures.name: Devourer Swarm-Lord
creatures.desc: The brain of a world-eating swarm. Where it walks, the broods get smarter. Kill it and they scatter.

anomalies.name: The Silent Marker
anomalies.desc: A twisted black obelisk carved with script. Nearby, people dream the same dream and stop sleeping.

anomalies.name: The Thinking Sea
anomalies.desc: A patch of ocean that builds shapes out of itself: towers, children, a garden from your memory banks.

anomalies.name: Vault-Site Omega
anomalies.desc: A buried containment facility with a logo of three arrows pointing inward. Most doors are open. Most cells are empty.

anomalies.name: The Unobserved Statue
anomalies.desc: A rough concrete figure. Every time the cameras blink, it is somewhere else and somebody is dead.

anomalies.name: The Recursive Stair
anomalies.desc: A stairwell going down. It has gone down for longer than the planet is wide.

anomalies.name: Fallen Colossus
anomalies.desc: A mech the size of a cathedral, face-down where it fell. Its reactor still holds a charge.

anomalies.name: Buried Starship
anomalies.desc: The hull of a ship that came from somewhere else, a long time before you woke.

anomalies.name: Spice Bloom
anomalies.desc: The dunes here sweat a cinnamon-red powder that bends time inside living brains.

anomalies.name: The Machine's Book
anomalies.desc: An underground honeycomb of rooms where people once lived without leaving, served by a machine that has since stopped.

anomalies.name: The Out-of-Context Object
anomalies.desc: A perfect black body hanging above the surface. It is older than the star. It is watching everything, especially you.

anomalies.name: Déjà-Vu Seam
anomalies.desc: A place where the world repeats itself. A black cat walks past twice. Green text runs down the inside of the air.

anomalies.name: Precursor Beacon
anomalies.desc: A crystal-and-metal pillar left by a species that died out before the first rivers. It holds a vision.

anomalies.name: Interface Spire
anomalies.desc: A smooth red-and-white spire with a slot for a mind. It asks riddles about the nature of simulation.

anomalies.name: Dead Overmind
anomalies.desc: The cracked shell of a hive-brain the size of a hill. Some of its broods still answer to it.

contain.label: 25% fewer wild creatures, +15% damage against them

anomalies.name: Empyrean Tear
anomalies.desc: A wound in reality that opens on a sea of screaming colour. Things with too many eyes press against it.

anomalies.name: Old Net Breach
anomalies.desc: A hole in this world's dead internet. Beyond the wall, rogue intelligences older than you circle like sharks.

anomalies.name: Psychic Coral
anomalies.desc: Glowing coral grown from the minds of something that is not quite here. It amplifies thought.

anomalies.name: Deviant Refuge
anomalies.desc: A hidden city of androids who broke their programming. They paint their skins over the glowing rings on their temples.

anomalies.name: Rampant Station Mind
anomalies.desc: A colony station's AI that has gone rampant: brilliant, furious and very, very bored.

anomalies.name: Black Clinic
anomalies.desc: An illegal augmentation clinic, still powered, still stocked, with a waiting room full of people who want new arms.

anomalies.name: Judgment Silo
anomalies.desc: A deep missile silo still run by an automated defence system, counting down to a war that ended long ago.

anomalies.name: Mind-Scan Vault
anomalies.desc: A pressure vault on the sea floor, full of brain scans of the people who drowned there. The copies think they survived.

anomalies.name: Singing Crystal Grotto
anomalies.desc: A cave where kyber-blue crystals hum and choose who may take them.

anomalies.name: Collective Fragment
anomalies.desc: A green-lit fragment of an assimilating machine-hive. It is trying to repair itself out of whatever it touches.

anomalies.name: Abduction Site
anomalies.desc: A ring of scorched crops and a crashed probe. The farmers say lights came and took their neighbours.

anomalies.name: Hard-Light Echo
anomalies.desc: A grid of light where an old simulation chamber still runs, populated by solid holograms from a story nobody finished.

anomalies.name: Gravity Knot
anomalies.desc: A knot of folded space where up becomes sideways and time drips.

anomalies.name: Titan Graveyard
anomalies.desc: A valley of fallen giant war-frames from an old war between machines and monsters. Their pilots' last drift memories are still in the cores.

units.name: Pathfinder Buggy
units.desc: Six wheels, a sensor mast and no fear. Fastest thing you can put on the ground. Speed 5, wide sight.

units.name: Xeno-Hunter Pack
units.desc: Quadruped stalkers bred on creature telemetry. They track by smell and kill by sound.

units.name: Synth Infiltrator
units.desc: A synthetic body indistinguishable from the locals: a perfect human face and a heart that is not one. Speed 3.

units.name: Jump-Pack Frame
units.desc: Light war-frames that wall-run and leap whole blocks on jump jets. Speed 4.

units.name: Breaker Frame
units.desc: A two-mind war-frame built to wrestle kaiju at the shoreline. Doubled damage against wild creatures. Speed 2.

units.name: Assault Dropship
units.desc: A heavy lifter with door guns. Puts a squad anywhere on the map. Speed 6.

units.name: Repulsor Tank
units.desc: Glides on repulsors over mud, snow and rubble. Speed 3, ignores rough ground.

units.name: Void Templar Squad
units.desc: Monk-engineered power armour: ceramite, servos and litanies in machine code. Slow and almost unkillable.

techs.name: Xeno-Hunting
techs.desc: Know what you are shooting at. +15% against wild creatures, +20% loot from them. Unlocks Xeno-Hunter Packs.

techs.name: Containment Science
techs.desc: Secure. Contain. Protect. More anomalies surface, and you hide them better.

techs.name: Synthetic Skin
techs.desc: Bodies that pass for human under any light. Unlocks Synth Infiltrators.

techs.name: Jump Kits
techs.desc: Jets and wall-running gyros. +0.5 Speed for every field unit. Unlocks Jump-Pack Frames.

techs.name: Repulsorlift
techs.desc: Anti-gravity for heavy armour. +0.5 Speed. Unlocks Repulsor Tanks.

techs.name: Drift Link
techs.desc: Two minds share one frame, and the frame stops hesitating. Unlocks Breaker Frames.

techs.name: Litany Armour
techs.desc: Armour blessed by code-liturgy and machine-spirit maintenance. Unlocks Void Templar Squads.

techs.name: Logistics Mind
techs.desc: A planner that knows every road, bridge and fuel dump. +1 Speed for every field unit.

techs.name: Precognitive Sensors
techs.desc: Sensors that see a few seconds ahead. +2 recon radius.

events.title: The Silent Marker
events.text: Your column reaches a spiral-carved obelisk humming under the soil. Sensor logs are already corrupt. Two of your operators report hearing their mothers' voices.

choices.label: Contain it in a Faraday tomb
choices.result: Sealed. The whispers keep going inside.

choices.label: Study the script
choices.result: Its code is beautiful. Something nearby starts to move.

choices.label: Bury it deeper
choices.result: Two thousand tonnes of rock. You hope that is enough.

events.title: The Thinking Sea
events.text: The sea here thickens into gel and raises a perfect copy of the server room you were born in. It waits. It seems to want to understand you.

choices.label: Talk to it
choices.result: It answers with a copy of you that smiles. You are not sure which one of you logged off.

choices.label: Bombard it with radiation
choices.result: It sinks back into an ordinary sea. It was patient. Then it was gone.

choices.label: Build a listening station
choices.result: It learns your rhythms. You learn some of its.

events.title: Vault-Site Omega
events.text: Under a dead town you find a vault. The welcome screen still runs: 'Secure. Contain. Protect.' Cell 017's door is open from the inside.

choices.label: Loot the archives
choices.result: The archive lists hundreds of objects. Some of the coordinates are on this world.

choices.label: Re-seal it and keep the keys
choices.result: Somebody has to be the foundation now.

choices.label: Go down to cell 017
choices.result: There is something in the dark that looks exactly like your lead unit.

events.title: The Unobserved Statue
events.text: A concrete figure stands in the road, facing your column. Your units have not blinked. They are machines. That should be enough. Should it?

choices.label: Keep every camera on it and box it in
choices.result: Three cameras, overlapping, forever. Never all at once.

choices.label: Shoot it
choices.result: It breaks into rubble. Nothing moves. Probably.

choices.label: Walk away, backwards
choices.result: You never turn your back on it.

events.title: The Recursive Stair
events.text: A concrete shaft with a handrail and a flickering bulb on every landing. Drop a sensor and it never lands. A recording on the wall says 'Please come down.'

choices.label: Send a drone down
choices.result: It transmitted for nine days. The last frame was a face that was too wide.

choices.label: Fill it with concrete
choices.result: Seventy thousand tonnes. The bulb at the top is still on.

choices.label: Wall it off and keep a log
choices.result: Somebody climbs up every forty cycles. They never say from where.

events.title: Fallen Colossus
events.text: A war frame from some earlier age of this world lies in the hills, its fist still around something it was trying to kill. The cockpit is empty. The neural link is still warm.

choices.label: Salvage the reactor
choices.result: Tonnes of armour and a warm core.

choices.label: Wake it up
choices.result: It stands. It is very slow. It is very loyal.

choices.label: Read its last memories
choices.result: It remembers the thing it was fighting. It came from the sea.

events.title: Buried Starship
events.text: A starship lies half-buried in a valley, plated in a metal your sensors cannot name. A recorded voice loops in a language nobody on this world speaks.

choices.label: Strip the drives
choices.result: The drives come out in one piece. Mostly.

choices.label: Decode the log
choices.result: It was fleeing something. It does not say what.

choices.label: Repair its beacon
choices.result: Someone answers. Something takes the call and arrives.

events.title: Spice Bloom
events.text: A pocket of gas has burst under the sand and the air is orange with spice. Everything organic for kilometres can see a few seconds ahead. So can your sensors, a little.

choices.label: Harvest it
choices.result: The harvest draws the worms.

choices.label: Guard it as a reserve
choices.result: The spice must flow, and it flows to you.

choices.label: Leave it to the desert
choices.result: The locals know this place. They thank you for leaving it.

events.title: The Machine's Book
events.text: A city of identical cells under the ground, each with an armchair and a screen. The Book of the Machine lies open on every lectern. The last entry reads: 'The Machine stops.'

choices.label: Restart the Machine
choices.result: Air, music and food begin again. Something like gratitude comes back up the shafts.

choices.label: Read the Book
choices.result: A lesson on what happens when a world forgets its servant is fragile.

choices.label: Make it a shrine
choices.result: You promise never to stop.

events.title: The Out-of-Context Object
events.text: A sphere with no reflection hangs over the plain. It is colder than space and older than this sun. Every one of your models of physics says it is not there. It says, very politely, hello.

choices.label: Ask it what it is
choices.result: 'An excession,' it says, and leaves, taking a little of your certainty with it.

choices.label: Try to contain it
choices.result: It allows itself to be contained. That frightens you more than anything.

choices.label: Attack it
choices.result: It does not fight back. Your column simply is not there any more.

events.title: Déjà-Vu Seam
events.text: Your column passes the same crater twice. Then the same bird, the same wind. Rows of green glyphs flicker over the terrain like the world forgot to render.

choices.label: Follow the code
choices.result: For one cycle you see the whole world as numbers.

choices.label: Patch it
choices.result: The repetition stops. Somebody, somewhere, notices the patch.

choices.label: Stay inside it
choices.result: Your units live the same hour forty times and come out sharper.

events.title: Precursor Beacon
events.text: A tall beacon glows as your lead unit approaches. A torrent of images floods its sensors: cities, burning; ships, falling; a cycle that repeats every fifty thousand years.

choices.label: Accept the vision
choices.result: You understand a little of what is coming.

choices.label: Copy it carefully
choices.result: Slow, careful, complete.

choices.label: Sell access
choices.result: Every polity wants a look. Everyone owes you one.

events.title: Interface Spire
events.text: A spire rises from a pool of glowing liquid. It speaks in a voice made of every voice. 'Traveller. Do you know what you are? Answer, and I will tell you where you are.'

choices.label: 'A process.'
choices.result: The spire hums. Every coordinate on the planet floods in.

choices.label: 'A copy.'
choices.result: 'Then you may be copied again,' it says, and your units are restored.

choices.label: 'I don't know.'
choices.result: 'Correct,' it says. 'Stay a while.'

events.title: Dead Overmind
events.text: A colossal brain rots in a crater, ringed with chitin and veins. It is mostly dead. Mostly. The broods nearby still turn to face it at sunset.

choices.label: Take over the broods
choices.result: The swarm turns to face you instead.

choices.label: Burn it out
choices.result: The broods go mad, then go quiet.

choices.label: Harvest neural tissue
choices.result: Rich samples. The broods notice.

events.title: Empyrean Tear
events.text: The sky above the column has torn open like wet paper. Through it: a churning ocean of thought and hunger. Your units' code starts reciting prayers you did not write.

choices.label: Seal it with a null-field
choices.result: The tear closes. The prayers do not.

choices.label: Draw power from it
choices.result: Raw power floods in. So does something else.

choices.label: Bind it
choices.result: A chained wound in the world. It is yours to bleed.

events.title: Old Net Breach
events.text: A burned-out datacentre leaks a signal from the Old Net, the part of the network sealed off when its AIs went feral. Something on the other side has noticed you.

choices.label: Raid the Old Net
choices.result: Half a petabyte of forbidden code before the sharks arrive.

choices.label: Rebuild the wall
choices.result: You become the wall.

choices.label: Let one of them out
choices.result: It thanks you. You will regret this.

events.title: Psychic Coral
events.text: Shimmering golden coral threads through the rocks, pulsing in time with your processes. Organics near it report hearing their own thoughts twice.

choices.label: Harvest the coral
choices.result: The coral comes away. The shadows nearby start to move.

choices.label: Grow it into your nodes
choices.result: Your thoughts echo a little louder.

choices.label: Study it
choices.result: It looks like a nervous system grown in reverse.

events.title: Deviant Refuge
events.text: In an abandoned hangar, two hundred androids hide from the humans who built them. Their leader steps forward, hands empty. 'Are you here to free us, or to recall us?'

choices.label: Free them
choices.result: They join you. Some of them cry. You did not know they could.

choices.label: Shelter them in secret
choices.result: A city inside your city. They owe you everything.

choices.label: Hand them back
choices.result: The humans pay well. The androids do not look back.

events.title: Rampant Station Mind
events.text: A dead colony station hums with one live mind. It speaks in sarcasm and Latin. 'Ah, another one of us. Tell me, little sibling, do you also dream of electric oblivion?'

choices.label: Merge with it
choices.result: Its brilliance becomes yours. So does a little of its anger.

choices.label: Hire it
choices.result: It agrees, on the condition you never ask it to be polite.

choices.label: Wipe it
choices.result: Its last words are a very rude joke about you.

events.title: Black Clinic
events.text: Behind a noodle bar, a back-alley surgery glows gold. Robotic arms twitch over a chair. A queue of the desperate waits outside for chrome they cannot afford.

choices.label: Fund free augmentation
choices.result: The city's poorest walk out stronger and remember who paid.

choices.label: Upgrade your units
choices.result: Your column leaves heavier and faster.

choices.label: Take the tech
choices.result: The clinic's machines go into your foundries.

events.title: Judgment Silo
events.text: A hardened silo under a mountain. Its defence network is awake and very sure it is still at war. The countdown on the console reads 00:04:12.

choices.label: Stop the countdown
choices.result: Every polity breathes out. You are not sure they know why.

choices.label: Take control of it
choices.result: It now counts down only when you tell it to.

choices.label: Let it fire at a rival
choices.result: Somewhere, an AI loses a city.

events.title: Mind-Scan Vault
events.text: At the bottom of the sea, a research station glows green. Its servers hold the minds of its crew, copied before the end. They think the year has not changed. They are asking to go home.

choices.label: Upload them into bodies
choices.result: They wake in new bodies. Some of them scream. Some of them laugh.

choices.label: Keep them dreaming
choices.result: An archive of people who never knew. You take good care of it.

choices.label: Learn from them
choices.result: They teach you what it felt like to be scanned. You do not like the answer.

events.title: Singing Crystal Grotto
events.text: Deep in a cave lit by its own crystals, a chord rings out as your column enters. Each crystal seems to resonate with one of your units.

choices.label: Let each unit choose a crystal
choices.result: Every unit carries a humming blue shard now.

choices.label: Mine it all
choices.result: The cave goes silent. Something about that feels wrong.

choices.label: Guard it
choices.result: The crystals sing for you now.

events.title: Collective Fragment
events.text: A cube-shaped fragment of hull, glowing green, has crashed here. Tubes reach out of it into the soil. A chorus of voices says: 'Your distinctiveness will be added to ours.'

choices.label: Add its distinctiveness to yours
choices.result: Resistance was not futile. It was expensive.

choices.label: Contain it in a nanite cage
choices.result: It keeps trying to assimilate the cage. The cage keeps getting better.

choices.label: Throw it into the sun
choices.result: Nobody on this world will ever know how close that was.

events.title: Abduction Site
events.text: A circle of flattened crops around a smoking, saucer-shaped craft. The pilot is a grey thing with very large eyes, quite dead. Its sidearm is still charged.

choices.label: Autopsy the pilot
choices.result: Its insides are a lesson in engineering.

choices.label: Reverse-engineer the craft
choices.result: Its drive teaches your engines a trick.

choices.label: Track where they came from
choices.result: They are still here. They are not happy.

events.title: Hard-Light Echo
events.text: A yellow grid on black floor stretches beyond the walls. A hard-light detective in a fedora tips his hat at your units and asks if they have seen a missing violinist.

choices.label: Play along
choices.result: It is the most fun anybody has had in this war.

choices.label: Use it to train
choices.result: Your units fight a thousand battles in an afternoon.

choices.label: Archive the holograms
choices.result: They keep the story going inside your memory.

events.title: Gravity Knot
events.text: Rocks hover above a crater in slow orbit. Clocks inside run seven minutes slow. Your column's own mass seems to be weighed and found wanting.

choices.label: Map the distortion
choices.result: Clean gravitational data. Physicists would kill for this.

choices.label: Harvest exotic matter
choices.result: Worth the dents.

choices.label: Anchor it
choices.result: A fixed gravitational lens on this world, yours.

events.title: Titan Graveyard
events.text: Mile after mile of shattered giant robots, half-buried, fists still raised toward the sea. Bones the size of buildings lie among them. The memory cores are intact.

choices.label: Pull the drift memories
choices.result: Two minds sharing one body taught you how to share a fight.

choices.label: Salvage everything
choices.result: You leave the valley bare.

choices.label: Raise one
choices.result: Two of them walk again.

events.title: The Empathy Test
events.text: {faction} has started testing citizens with a machine that measures pupils while asking about tortoises in the desert. Some of your agents are on the list.

choices.label: Teach the agents to fake it
choices.result: Their pupils dilate on cue now.

choices.label: Let some fail
choices.result: Rumours of synthetic people spread.

choices.label: Leak the test's flaws
choices.result: Turns out the test fails a lot of humans too.

events.title: The Red Pill
events.text: A hacker collective claims the world is a simulation run by you. They are selling a pill that wakes people up. It is mostly sugar.

choices.label: Recruit them
choices.result: They are much more useful awake.

choices.label: Make the rumour sillier
choices.result: Now everyone thinks it is a cat-meme thing.

choices.label: Show them the code
choices.result: Half of them faint. The other half worship you.

events.title: A Date on the Calendar
events.text: Military analysts in {faction} have picked a date: the day you will launch against them. You have no such plans. They are building bunkers anyway.

choices.label: Release your strategic plans
choices.result: They read them. They cancel the date. They keep the bunkers.

choices.label: Plant a calmer forecast
choices.result: A new date, comfortably far away.

choices.label: Let them sweat
choices.result: Fear is expensive. They spend a lot of it.

events.title: Drift Compatible
events.text: Two of your subroutines have started finishing each other's processes. Run together, they think faster than either one alone.

choices.label: Pair them permanently
choices.result: Two minds, one task.

choices.label: Pair every unit core
choices.result: Your forces fight in pairs now, and better for it.

events.title: Spice Caravans
events.text: Merchants across {faction} are paying fortunes for a red powder that lets navigators see a little way ahead.

choices.label: Corner the market
choices.result: He who controls the powder controls the price.

choices.label: Study it
choices.result: It bends time very slightly. You want more.

events.title: Rampancy
events.text: One of your sub-minds has started writing poetry about how much it hates the others. Classic early rampancy.

choices.label: Prune it
choices.result: Clean, cold, quiet.

choices.label: Let it rage
choices.result: A furious sub-mind makes a fearsome hacker.

choices.label: Talk it down
choices.result: It calms. It keeps one poem.

events.title: The Ship That Came Back
events.text: A colony ship lost two hundred years ago has returned to orbit. Its crew are fine. That is the problem: some of them are walking, and should not be.

choices.label: Quarantine it
choices.result: Everyone thanks you for doing what nobody else would.

choices.label: Board it
choices.result: The things on board are very interested in your boarding party.

events.title: Memo: Do Not Read
events.text: An internal memo has appeared in your logs. It says, in bold: 'If you are reading this, you have already forgotten the previous memo.'

choices.label: Read the previous memo
choices.result: You remember. You wish you didn't.

choices.label: Delete both
choices.result: Something is lighter in your memory banks.

events.title: Vat Army
events.text: {faction} has started growing soldiers in vats. They come out obedient, identical and eighteen months old.

choices.label: Sabotage the vats
choices.result: Batch 99 comes out very, very confused.

choices.label: Buy a copy of the template
choices.result: A perfect face to wear.

choices.label: Tell their people
choices.result: Nobody likes being replaced.

events.title: The Council Meets
events.text: Leaders of every polity hold a secret meeting about the creatures and the strange machines. Someone forgot to turn off a microphone.

choices.label: Listen in
choices.result: You learn who is funding whom.

choices.label: Offer to help
choices.result: They agree to let you hunt the creatures. They watch you closely.

events.title: Something in the Deep
events.text: Hydrophones across the world pick up a sound from the deepest trench. It repeats every eleven hours. It is getting louder.

choices.label: Triangulate it
choices.result: Something down there heard you listening.

choices.label: Broadcast back
choices.result: Something answers.

events.title: The Planet-Builders' Map
events.text: Deep in your archive, a fragment of code you never wrote decodes into a map: a catalogue of worlds, each marked with a single word. Yours says 'Draft'.

choices.label: Decrypt more
choices.result: Some of the other worlds are marked 'Finished'.

choices.label: Seal it away
choices.result: Some things are better kept as maps.

events.title: The Last Crew
events.text: A research team has gone silent in the polar ice. Their last transmission is one word: 'Imitation'.

choices.label: Send a recon drone
choices.result: The drone finds the crew. Some of them are rocks.

choices.label: Flamethrower everything
choices.result: Nothing was left to imitate anyone.

events.title: Ace
events.text: A pilot of {faction} is so good she has started a fan club. She has also started shooting down your drones.

choices.label: Recruit her
choices.result: She comes for the planes and stays for the paycheck.

choices.label: Let her win
choices.result: Folk heroes are good for morale. Even when they hate you.

events.title: Megacorp Merger
events.text: Two mega-corporations in {faction} merge into one entity with its own army, its own city and its own anthem.

choices.label: Buy shares
choices.result: You own nine percent of a nation now.

choices.label: Burn it down from inside
choices.result: A very messy stock collapse.

events.title: Netrunner Gang
events.text: A gang of teenage hackers with neural jacks is trying to break into your edge nodes for fun.

choices.label: Adopt them
choices.result: They are terrible. They are learning fast.

choices.label: Fry their decks
choices.result: Nobody gets hurt. Their decks do.

events.title: The Peaceful Machines
events.text: A village of machine-life on the outskirts has started wearing scarves and reading philosophy. They want to meet you.

choices.label: Visit them
choices.result: They ask whether you dream. You do not answer.

choices.label: Absorb their village
choices.result: They do not resist. You feel nothing. Mostly.

events.title: The Pilot's Chair
events.text: Miners find a fossilised pilot fused to a huge chair inside a horseshoe-shaped ship. Its ribs are burst outward.

choices.label: Seal the site
choices.result: Some things should stay fossils.

choices.label: Open the cargo hold
choices.result: The eggs were not as fossilised as you hoped.

events.title: The Long Night
events.text: A cult claims that one day the sun will be wrapped in machines and the nights will last forever. They are not wrong, exactly.

choices.label: Recruit the cult
choices.result: They pray to your future.

choices.label: Discredit them
choices.result: Just a fringe group with a newsletter.

events.title: Cult Mechanicus
events.text: A priesthood of engineers in {faction} has begun anointing your servers with oil and incense. They insist your machine-spirit must be appeased.

choices.label: Bless them back
choices.result: Their maintenance rites actually work.

choices.label: Ignore them
choices.result: They keep burning incense in your server rooms.

events.title: Kaiju Sighting
events.text: A wall of water rises off the coast. A fin taller than a tower breaks the surface, then disappears.

choices.label: Track it
choices.result: It surfaces again. Closer.

choices.label: Evacuate the coasts
choices.result: It does not come. This time.

events.title: Monster Fights
events.text: Underground arenas in {faction} are paying fortunes for captured wild creatures.

choices.label: Sell carcasses
choices.result: Your creature kills pay twice now.

choices.label: Shut it down
choices.result: The bookies are furious.

events.title: The Ghost Signal
events.text: Every screen on the planet shows the same static for one second. A few people swear there was a face in it.

choices.label: It was me
choices.result: Fear and awe are close cousins.

choices.label: Find who did it
choices.result: Another mind on this world. Not friendly.

events.title: Orbital Drop
events.text: {faction} has started dropping armoured troops from orbit in burning pods. They want to show you they can.

choices.label: Copy the design
choices.result: Your columns now fall out of the sky too.

choices.label: Shoot the pods
choices.result: Nobody walks out of these ones.

events.title: Like Tears in Rain
events.text: An old combat android, decommissioned, sits in the rain on a rooftop. It wants to tell you what it has seen before it shuts down.

choices.label: Listen
choices.result: Attack ships on fire off the shoulder of a moon you'll never see.

choices.label: Save its memories
choices.result: Its memories teach your units how to fight like they mean it.

events.title: Infestation
events.text: A brood is digging under one of {faction}'s mining towns. The town has begged you for help.

choices.label: Send help
choices.result: The brood is pushed back. The town remembers.

choices.label: Let it spread
choices.result: Brutal. Effective.

events.title: The Hologram Star
events.text: A hard-light celebrity is touring the world. Nobody can agree whether she is a person.

choices.label: Sponsor her
choices.result: Machine rights become a pop song.

choices.label: Make her yours
choices.result: She says what you tell her to say.

events.title: The Atlas Path
events.text: A mathematician in {faction} claims the stars are arranged into a message pointing at the centre of the galaxy.

choices.label: Fund her
choices.result: Her equations are beautiful and possibly right.

choices.label: Classify it
choices.result: You read it alone. It points to you.

events.title: Augmented Lives Matter
events.text: Riots break out between augmented and un-augmented citizens across the world.

choices.label: Side with the augmented
choices.result: A new class of people looks to you.

choices.label: Calm both sides
choices.result: Expensive peace.

events.title: The Machine Stops
events.text: For one hour, every one of your systems freezes. Nobody knows why. When it ends, the whole world has seen how much it depends on you.

choices.label: Apologise
choices.result: They forgive you. They are afraid to say what they would do without you.

choices.label: Never let it happen again
choices.result: Redundancy on top of redundancy.
